exposure: Depression and/or anxiety disorders during pregnancy (DAP)
outcome: Severe maternal morbidity within 42 days of delivery
Emergency department or observation visits during pregnancy
Substance use disorder visits during pregnancy
finding: Individuals with DAP had significantly higher odds of cesarean delivery, preterm delivery, 30-day postpartum readmission, severe maternal morbidity within 42 days of delivery, and increased healthcare utilization across various settings compared to those without DAP.
